cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a hanfu photo studio with costume racks — holds a white feather fan upright at chest height; a night observatory under an open dome — holds a book closed against her chest; the Wuhou Shrine in Chengdu — brings a cup to her lips; a Han-era inn — holds a gourd-shaped wine flask on a red cord by its cord at chest height; an open-air hot spring among steaming rocks — dries her hair with a towel; a mountain lodge with a front counter and a fireplace — standing; a lantern-lit old-town street at night — standing; a circus tent ring under a striped canopy — sitting on the ground; the rail of a harbour ferry deck in the wind — standing at a waist-high railing or sill; a starship data archive — holds a cup in both hands; a rooftop infinity pool with the city skyline behind it — holds a towel folded against her chest; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — holds her keepsake at chest height; an old Chengdu teahouse with bamboo chairs — holds a bound bundle of bamboo slips against her chest
